func isPresent(value expression) condition {
	return func(context scope, at string) (bool, error) {
		result, err := value(context, at+"/value")
		return !isMissing(result), err
	}
}
func asBoolean(value expression) condition {
	return func(context scope, at string) (bool, error) {
		result, err := present(value, context, at+"/value")
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		boolean, ok := result.(bool)
		if !ok {
			return false, refusal(at, "boolean_value", "condition is not a boolean")
		}
		return boolean, nil
	}
}
func equalValues(left, right expression) condition {
	return func(context scope, at string) (bool, error) {
		a, err := left(context, at+"/left")
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		b, err := right(context, at+"/right")
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		if isMissing(a) || isMissing(b) {
			return false, nil
		}
		if left, ok := a.(float64); ok {
			if right, ok := b.(float64); ok { return left == right, nil }
		}
		for _, value := range []any{a, b} {
			switch value.(type) {
			case int64, uint64, float64:
				if _, err := integer(value, at); err != nil {
					return false, err
				}
			}
		}
		return reflect.DeepEqual(a, b), nil
	}
}
func greaterThan(left, right expression) condition {
	return func(context scope, at string) (bool, error) {
		a, err := present(left, context, at+"/left")
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		x, err := integer(a, at)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		b, err := present(right, context, at+"/right")
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		y, err := integer(b, at)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		return x > y, nil
	}
}
func startsWith(value, prefix expression) condition {
	return func(context scope, at string) (bool, error) {
		a, err := present(value, context, at+"/value")
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		b, err := present(prefix, context, at+"/prefix")
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		text, ok := a.(string)
		start, other := b.(string)
		if !ok || !other {
			return false, refusal(at, "string_value", "prefix comparison requires strings")
		}
		return strings.HasPrefix(text, start), nil
	}
}
func allOf(tests []condition) condition {
	return func(context scope, at string) (bool, error) {
		for index, test := range tests {
			value, err := test(context, fmt.Sprintf("%s/conditions/%d", at, index))
			if err != nil || !value {
				return false, err
			}
		}
		return true, nil
	}
}
func anyOf(tests []condition) condition {
	return func(context scope, at string) (bool, error) {
		for index, test := range tests {
			value, err := test(context, fmt.Sprintf("%s/conditions/%d", at, index))
			if err != nil {
				return false, err
			}
			if value {
				return true, nil
			}
		}
		return false, nil
	}
}
func negate(test condition) condition {
	return func(context scope, at string) (bool, error) {
		value, err := test(context, at+"/condition")
		return !value, err
	}
}
